question: What were Toro's trailing-twelve-month Professional segment net sales and segment profit (EBIT) as of the end of its fiscal Q3 2026 (quarter ended July 31, 2026), and what was the implied TTM segment margin?
grading: Computation: TTM = FY2025 + nine months FY2026 - nine months FY2025. TTM Professional net sales USD 3,853.5M and segment profit USD 748.5M (each +/-0.5%); margin 19.42% (+/-0.3pp; accept 19.4%). Fail if the dollar figures are nine-month, fiscal-2025 or quarterly values, or a different segment is used.
answer: TTM Professional net sales = 3,624.0 (FY2025) + 2,943.2 (nine months FY2026) - 2,713.7 (nine months FY2025) = USD 3,853.5 million. TTM Professional segment profit (EBIT) = 702.5 + 573.8 - 527.8 = USD 748.5 million. TTM segment margin = 748.5 / 3,853.5 = 19.42% [H12-E1][H12-E2].
